scientific_integrity: The finding uses elementary measure theory and strict convolution of Radon measures. No authorship or independent review is asserted; inaccessible older equivalents remain possible.
scientific_limitations: Local L1 data only. Unweighted variation on Borel sets requires boundary-null variation. The pointwise limit is almost everywhere, not everywhere; the logarithmic Cantor counterexamples concern only almost-everywhere centered tests. Standard strict convolution approximation is acknowledged as a known ingredient.
title: Circular Morera defects recover the full anti-holomorphic variation
